caption:
When the ridge gets too steep to skin, the board goes on the pack and you walk. One step at a time, wind on your face, the summit somewhere up there in the light.

Nobody talks much on a bootpack. You just find your rhythm and keep moving — and the silence up there is half the reason we come.

Splitboarders are always welcome on our weeks. Send us a message if you want to join next season.
